## Requirements

- `GOAL-MAP`: A goal map shows every goal on a canvas that can be panned, zoomed and rearranged: north stars at the top, solid lines for feeds into, dotted lines for also helps, branches that fold and unfold, the list bar's Needs attention switch, and the critical path (the inputs most likely to make each top goal miss) drawn bold. It works at the size of a division (126 goals): it opens folded to the top goals with only the critical path beneath them; the trees wrap into rows so Fit all shows every goal; the list bar's search, on the Map, lists the goals it finds by name or key (G-48), and choosing one opens its tree, outlines it and moves to it without narrowing the Map (Enter with nothing chosen narrows, as on every layout); each goal shows its number, target and gap, and a goal others feed shows the worst status of everything under it (the List's roll-up, by the group-status rule); Troubled trees only keeps the trees with anything off track, at risk or without a recent update; the map refits whenever what it shows changes, and draws at once, with no staged wait. Selecting a goal shows its story beside the map. The map never removes a goal: Delete and Backspace do nothing on it. On a phone the same map is indented, one goal per row. (Copy.)
- `MAP-OPTIONAL`: An admin switches the Goal map off for a workspace. Off, Goals offers no Map, and a link or saved view that asked for it opens the List and says so. (Copy.)
